question: Does factual-return-only intermediate internal microfeedback solve withheld PARITY+NEGATE composition on the authentic width32 native CPU reference when ordinary end-to-end reward gradients failed? Does true microfeedback beat otherwise-identical zero-feedback, stem-only feedback and scrambled-feedback controls, plus fully trained flat MLP, role-set and GRU, without additional private-law teaching?

source.public_instruction: Use new fresh R85 pure physical 224-tick worlds and original R98 pure preaction public operator tagging and compression, selecting the 5 original 13D public A-role/pivot rows. Four actual noisy factors/role identity/phase, explicit publicly available selector+yes+no tags and both opcode bits; never private law or unchosen payoff. All learners see exactly same legal facts.
source.factual_action: CALIBRATE if ((index//4)+seed_index)%2==0 else EXPLOIT_POS, balanced cold/action strata; only one realized physical 9-tick reward under that chosen action for every FIT/VALID world.
source.training_law: Independently sample A factors from new seed/panel/index RNG and recompute public MUX+NEGATE, PARITY, or withheld PARITY+NEGATE physical hidden A law with original R98.law_of pure function. Original index-coded source law overwritten. Never access R98._world or scored R98 panels.
source.heldout: No DEV_SEEN, DEV_COMPOSE, OOD_SHIFT or PROGRAM_SWITCH world exists until all nine arms trained on FIT/VALID and final parameters freeze. Fresh paired legal actions for evaluator only; no return leak to training.
source.program_switch: On exact same fresh heldout PARITY+NEGATE world, change public program to MUX+NEGATE while preserving A/B factors, noise, timing, chosen action prefix, and recompute true physical law; measure action flips only where the law changes, no adaptation. NOT same as full 224-step cold retention.
source.shift: OOD_SHIFT uses R86 pure shifted probe/noise timing on same withheld program + role assignment, not novel physics primitive.
source.shuffled_microfeedback: At the start of FIT/VALID, independently seed-only rejection-sample a zero-fixed-point derangement of example indices WITHIN publicly observed pivot time and actual chosen-action groups, no law or target inspection. Only auxiliary intermediate head losses use donor realized factual rewards, NEVER the main correct factual reward. Preserve action/pivot grouping; no adaptive selection/retry after outcome.
source.shuffle_independence_audit: After fixed permutation, evaluator-only donor/recipient PRIVATE A-law agreement should lie in [0.35,0.65] per FIT and VALID; reject as invalid if failed, do not resample based on result. This is a target-shuffle negative, not proof other public cues become independent.
source.privacy: No learned candidate receives hidden true law, engineered parity/mux sign, oracle unchosen return, private A factors, or test source for any training. Only lawful public input and same single factual selected payoff.

architecture.native: Existing exact R74 width32 HybridPilot_FULL and equivalent R75 triangular TTT core and R98 public role+program 32D injection INSIDE pivot native STEM before original SSM, causal attention, TTT and hard depth. No changes to model.py/official GPU fused architecture.
architecture.deep_microfeedback: Separate four scalar auxiliary value heads at pivot immediately after STEM injection, after native SSM, after native attention, after native TTT (before original depth/head). Each auxiliary head predicts ONLY the SAME ACTUAL FACTUAL return already used by original output value loss. Main value MSE plus lambda 0.15 times MEAN of four intermediate factual-return MSEs, gradients reach native trunk. No extra knowledge/teacher, only deeper credit assignment.
architecture.main_only: Bitwise identical initialization and architecture, all auxiliary heads forward-computed, but lambda 0. All nine arms see same FIT minibatches and optimizer steps; main-only head receives no auxiliary optimizer updates.
architecture.deranged: Bitwise identical starting core/context/all auxiliary heads and exact same objective weight 0.15 but intermediate heads predict fixed cross-world donor selected factual returns within public action/time grouping. Main final value head STILL trained on its own TRUE factual return.
architecture.stem_only: Same architecture, final loss plus lambda 0.15 on only stem head. Provides depth ablation for where feedback helps; compute all heads same as positive.
architecture.conventional: Same FIT physical input/action/reward train 14D flat MLP64, 14D role-program conditioned learned set, and existing GRU64 5×13 public action/role observations; all full training budget.
architecture.engineered_upper: R98 hand-coded parity/mux evaluation from legally observed noisy cues/operator/roles made public 14D engineered first feature plus 14D conventional MLP64 trained on SAME factual action reward. This is a programmed public-rule diagnostic reference, never learned invention.
architecture.matching: Four internal adapter variants have identical parameter counts, exact initialized native/context/heads and same forward head computation. They differ ONLY auxiliary loss supervision. Conventional architectures have different params/unroll/FLOPs; disclose end-to-end cost and do not claim matched-FLOP scientific superiority.

execution.runner: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu CPU, first attempt only
